$comment: Shared forbidden-phrase gate for every publishable Gami surface:
the marketing site (gami-web), the wallet app, the browser extension and the webapp.
This file is the single source of truth. Copy it, do not fork it.
Patterns are JavaScript regular expression sources, applied case-insensitively
to rendered text: DOM textContent, meta and Open Graph values, JSON-LD, and
sitemap contents. Do NOT apply them to bundled source or to class names --
an SPA's crawlable surface is its rendered DOM, and CSS class names like
Adding an exception requires written legal clearance recorded in
docs/legal-hold/. See SECTION 8 of the site remediation brief.
